title: The protocol uses `_msgSender()` extensively, but not everywhere
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low, because protocol will still function normally, but an expectedly desired types of transactions won't work  **Likelihood:** High, because it is certain that he issue will occur as code is  ## Description  The code is using OpenZeppelin's `Context` contract which is intended to allow meta-transactions. It works by using doing a call to `_msgSender()` instead of querying `msg.sender` directly, because the method allows those special transactions.
